title: Connect event inspector
blurb: Connects to a fresh or existing SharedWorker and reads back all 10 fields of the browser-fired connect MessageEvent inside SharedWorkerGlobalScope against the HTML spec.
question: Does the browser-fired SharedWorker connect MessageEvent initialize e.data to "" on both the first connection (run a worker) and later connections (SharedWorker constructor)?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153, both the first connection (run a worker) and the second connection (existing-worker constructor branch) reported e.data === null (typeof "object"), while the remaining 8 fields (origin, lastEventId, frozen ports array, source === ports[0], bubbles, cancelable, isTrusted) matched the HTML spec. Chrome 160 empty-string branch not verified.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 (legacy null branch verified); not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: Chrome 159 and earlier initialize SharedWorker connect MessageEvent.data to null instead of the HTML spec empty string
friction.repro: Open a SharedWorker on Chrome <= 159 (or Chrome 160+ with --disable-blink-features=SharedWorkerConnectEventEmptyStringData) and read e.data in onconnect; it returns null instead of "".
friction.workaround: Do not branch on e.data inside a connect handler; read e.ports[0] (or e.source) and identify connect events by e.type === "connect".
